message: Reviewer 1 completed .NET11 MCP dispatch integration review 1f6f65c76d404f0fbf1ee6c05c37f834 frozen merge 93b2a2520caf3512441b5d3eed6e443606a679b5: CHANGES REQUESTED v3, one independently REPRODUCED P2 integration defect. The merged Program.fs wraps every incoming command in CommandDispatchQueue(8/128), but Client.fs receiveCommandAndReplyWithTiming then submits actual command+response to BoundedResponseIngress(96) and *returns Task.CompletedTask* instead of its completion Task. Thus outer 8 workers free immediately, up to 96 actual operations run, and premature inner capacity rejection is misreported as UncertainOutcome even though no work executed; unexpected inner runtime exceptions only log, never trigger outer correlated replyUnhandled, leaving server to time out. Two separate negative NUnit probes in detached exact-frozen reviewer checkout FAILED as expected: (a) scaled 2-worker outer + 4-slot inner accepted six then falsely rejected two (expected 0 actual 2); (b) inner injected fault never triggered outer correlated handler (expected true actual false). Full independent original net11 Release Client 591/591 (job 2bd2b90c...), Server 126/126 (d2b7e88b...) PASSED. Other manual conflicts preserve PendingJob vs UncertainOutcome unknown/known evidence, op IDs, protocol fields. Frozen HEAD/diff check/current main merge-tree clean. Require one authoritative execution dispatch owner; queue work while worker busy, proper confirmed-zero preexecution rejection, prompt correlated postexecution unknown response, preserve auto-job protocol. Details in summary.md and findings/p2-double-dispatch-detaches-work-and-drops-recovery.md. Re-submit corrected frozen integration for review; no merge/deploy.
